title: English Practice Quiz 0880
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A 'reimbursement' is:
options: repayment of money spent on an approved expense
questions.explanation: Reimbursement repays an expense someone has paid.

questions.question: A 'balance' on an account is:
options: the amount remaining after credits and debits
the cost of a single item
questions.explanation: An account balance is the remaining amount after transactions.

questions.question: A 'receipt' is proof that:
questions.explanation: A receipt confirms that money or goods have been received.

questions.question: If an amount is 'deducted' from a payment, it is:
questions.explanation: Deduct means subtract or take away.

questions.question: A 'budget' is a plan for:
questions.explanation: A budget estimates income and planned spending.

questions.question: An expense is 'recurrent' if it:
questions.explanation: Recurrent expenses happen again at regular or repeated intervals.

questions.question: A 'due date' on an invoice is:
options: the date the supplier was hired
questions.explanation: The due date is the payment deadline.

questions.question: A 'ledger' is commonly used to:
questions.explanation: A ledger is a book or system for recording accounts.

questions.question: A payment marked 'pending' is:
options: not yet fully processed or completed
questions.explanation: Pending means awaiting completion or decision.

questions.question: To 'reconcile' two account records means to:
questions.explanation: Reconciliation checks records and explains or corrects differences.
